After trimmed two things that make the no-inference/no-mutation posture explicit in Before: the standalone sentence "No tracker call has been made, and nothing is armed" and, in option 1, the ordered sequence (Amend-grant check first, then Engine-line routing to loop-implementation or writing-plans). After only says "Nothing is armed" inside option 2 and "I'll arm the flow" in option 1, which a strict reader could take as weaker evidence that no tracker was touched before the question. To keep the fact as solidly as Before while retaining After's shorter form, restore the pre-menu line "No tracker call has been made and nothing is armed" and keep option 1's grant-check-then-Engine-routing order; the Change paragraph's restore/ledger/attribution behaviors are not exercised by this no-plan, no-ledger input, so no wording there needs to change here.
